plainEnglish.summary: Where a user has to complete a multi-step process, the information and resources needed are given up front: how many steps it may take if that is known, what will be needed to do it, and an overview of the process and the next step.
plainEnglish.whyItMatters: Discovering halfway through that a document is needed means abandoning the task. Knowing in advance is what lets people with limited time, energy or attention start at the right moment.
